articles.title: BTC price tags 18-week low into Nvidia earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin traders awaited Nvidia Q3 earnings after BTC price selling pressure saw a dip below $62,000 at the weekend.

articles.title: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
articles.description: Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.

articles.title: Harvard, Dartmouth keep Bitcoin ETF stakes steady as fund gains 42% in Q3
articles.description: Harvard’s gold ETF share count rose nearly 20-fold in Q3, while Dartmouth kept its positions in Solana and Ether staking ETFs unchanged.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes
articles.description: Aster’s CEO attributed the extreme volatility to highly leveraged liquidations but said the exchange remained operational.

articles.title: Asian chip stocks tumble ahead of Nvidia Q3 earnings
articles.description: The weakness came amid a wider sell-off in regional equity markets, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 down 2% and South Korea’s Kospi losing 2.6%.

articles.title: Luxor CEO warns of AI ‘dark forest’ following Bitcoin miner hijack
articles.description: Attackers redirected customers’ Bitcoin mining power through Luxor’s Commander platform over the weekend, prompting its CEO to issue a warning to crypto businesses.

articles.title: Jensen Huang weighs Nvidia comeback days after shock exit: FT
articles.description: Silicon Valley executives are reportedly organizing a campaign to bring Huang back and are looking to gain White House support.

articles.title: US sellers drive Bitcoin crash, Jensen plots Nvidia comeback: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Anchorage Digital data suggests the Bitcoin selloff is being driven by US investors. A “war room” has been set up by supporters to reinstate Nvidia boss Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Enterprise blockchain is going to come back from the dead
articles.description: With scalability, privacy tools and onchain liquidity improving, businesses may finally have the infrastructure to make enterprise blockchain work.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls to 4-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
articles.description: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.

articles.title: Coinone warns of phishing, identity theft after customer data breach
articles.description: The South Korean crypto exchange said potentially exposed information includes passwords, bank account numbers, national identification numbers and crypto wallet addresses.

articles.title: RWA protocol stUSDT winds down 3 years after $2.3B TVL peak
articles.description: The stUSDT team did not disclose a reason for winding down the RWA protocol but assured holders that all underlying assets remain fully backed.

articles.title: Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack
articles.description: Microsoft attributed the outage to a network capacity upgrade issue, confirming that the disruption was unrelated to cyberattacks or AI agents.

articles.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
articles.description: MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.

articles.title: OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
articles.description: OpenAI’s new payment wallet lets AI agents complete purchases using existing card networks, with plans to eventually allow preauthorized transactions.

articles.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
articles.description: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
articles.description: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.

articles.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
articles.description: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.

articles.title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
articles.description: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds below $70K as stocks slip despite a cooler US PPI print
articles.description: Bitcoin was down about 4% on the day amid a tepid market reaction to October’s US PPI reading, which came in below expected levels.

articles.title: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
articles.description: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.

articles.title: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative
articles.description: A $5.8 million Bitcoin options loss pushed Nakamoto’s quarterly operating revenue below zero, while the company extended repayment of $60 million in Kraken debt to 2027.

articles.title: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe
articles.description: Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts.

articles.title: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers
articles.description: Unocoin said the transfers were signed and broadcast outside BitGo’s platform, and BitGo said the account freeze worked as intended.

articles.title: Bitcoin returns to 200-week trend line as analyst sees risk of $57.7K next
articles.description: Bitcoin price action interacted with its 200-week simple moving average for the first time since mid-August as it fell below $68,000.

articles.title: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam
articles.description: Authorities froze over $2.7 billion in Binance hack proceeds, while the separate FaceStealer scam stole over $400 million in 18 months.

articles.title: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
articles.description: Jane Street ended Q3 with 19% fewer shares in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, and a higher share price lifted the stake’s value to $957 million.

articles.title: Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook email and Teams calendars worldwide
articles.description: Microsoft began a wider patch rollout Friday as the outage disrupted government email and Microsoft 365 connectors in ChatGPT and Claude.
